feed.title: Collatz Conditional Cycles — Updates
feed.subtitle: Updates on the conditional formal proof of no non-trivial Collatz cycles in Lean 4.

entry.title: v0.5.1 — Bilingual EN-canonical website + interactive dependency graph + Cmd+K search
entry.summary:
Major UX upgrade to the public site:

  • EN-canonical localization with browser locale detection (FR fallback only for fr-* locales)
  • Interactive D3 force-directed dependency graph on /lemmes/ — drag, zoom, click nodes
  • Cmd+K / Ctrl+K / "/" search palette — full-text across pistes, theorems, lemmas, cf_gaps, PostJAR
  • Citation widget with 5 formats (BibTeX, APA 7, Chicago 17, RIS, plain)
  • Light / dark theme toggle with prefers-color-scheme auto-detect
  • Scroll progress bar + sticky TOC
  • Complete SEO infrastructure: sitemap.xml, robots.txt, JSON-LD ScholarlyArticle, hreflang FR/EN, Open Graph 1200×630, Twitter Cards, favicons

entry.title: v0.5.0 — JAR submission v1.1 + main result featured on homepage
entry.summary:

entry.title: v0.4.0 — Cycle 4 ChatGPT Lemmas patched + Cycle 5 Knight 2026 verified
entry.summary:
Research cycles 4 and 5:

  • Cycle 4 (CGS-7): 6 ChatGPT lemmas diagnosed and patched for Mathlib v4.27
  • Cycle 5 (Knight 2026): Section 5 (high cycles) verified UNCONDITIONAL via 2-adic argument; Section 3 (circuits) Baker-dependent
  • Mea culpa #24 (Salikhov 2007 not 2008) and #25 (Bost-Charles 2022 invented) documented

entry.title: v0.3.0 — JAR paper submitted to Journal of Automated Reasoning
entry.summary:
Paper submitted to JAR Springer:

On the non-existence of non-trivial Collatz cycles: a conditional formal proof in Lean 4 with documented structural obstructions

28 pages, kernel-checked Lean 4, 3 axiom profile (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound) + 3 documented external hypotheses (BakerSeparation, BarinaVerification, DerivedLargeKBound).

DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19790406
